Fuel trees (standing timber):
Discounted cash flows: The valuation model
considers the present value of the net cash
flows expected to be generated by the
plantation. The cash flow projections include
specific estimates for 8 years. The expected net
cash flows are discounted using a risk-adjusted
discount rate.
Green tea leaf:
The valuation model considers the
fair value of the un-harvested green
leaf tea as at December 2022.
Green tea leaf volumes were
determined by taking weighted
average of a 14 day plucking cycle.
This was then valued using the
2022 out-grower average price.
